C0237.title: Kuaishou Fined 119.1 Million Yuan by Cyberspace Authorities over Pornographic and Vulgar Livestream Content
C0237.summary: In February 2026, cyberspace authorities reported that Kuaishou had recently allowed a large volume of pornographic and vulgar livestream content and imposed a 119.1 million yuan fine. Kuaishou then issued an apology, saying the penalty exposed serious weaknesses in content review, ecosystem governance, and minor protection, and pledged comprehensive rectification.
